What is the minimum of the degree of a polynomial \(P{\left(x \right)}\) with real coefficients such that:
  • \(1 - 5 i\) is a root of multiplicity \(7\) ;
  • \(1 + 5 i\) is a root of multiplicity \(2\) ?
Answer -1 if you think that such polynomial does not exist.
